# The OS table's rows as shipped (native/os_calls.json's rows with an ELF ordinal), one line each:
# ordinal, name, prototype. A module built against any of them calls them by
# ordinal forever, so a line here is never changed, moved or removed: a new
# row is a new last line, written with the row it freezes. tests/test_os_table.py
# holds the table to this.
0 open | int open(const char *path, int flags, ...)
1 close | int close(int fd)
2 read | ssize_t read(int fd, void *buf, size_t n)
3 write | ssize_t write(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n)
4 lseek | off_t lseek(int fd, off_t at, int whence)
5 stat | int stat(const char *path, struct stat *st)
6 fstat | int fstat(int fd, struct stat *st)
7 isatty | int isatty(int fd)
8 unlink | int unlink(const char *path)
9 mkdir | int mkdir(const char *path, mode_t mode)
10 rmdir | int rmdir(const char *path)
11 rename | int rename(const char *from, const char *to)
12 opendir | DIR *opendir(const char *path)
13 readdir | struct dirent *readdir(DIR *dir)
14 closedir | int closedir(DIR *dir)
15 getcwd | char *getcwd(char *buf, size_t n)
16 getenv | char *getenv(const char *name)
17 exit | void exit(int code)
18 _exit | void _exit(int code)
19 __errno | int *__errno(void)
20 time | time_t time(time_t *t)
21 clock_gettime | int clock_gettime(clockid_t clock, struct timespec *ts)
22 gettimeofday | int gettimeofday(struct timeval *tv, void *tz)
23 nanosleep | int nanosleep(const struct timespec *req, struct timespec *rem)
24 usleep | int usleep(useconds_t us)
25 sleep | unsigned sleep(unsigned s)
26 pthread_create | int pthread_create(pthread_t *thread, const pthread_attr_t *attr, void *(*start)(void *), void *arg)
27 pthread_join | int pthread_join(pthread_t thread, void **out)
28 pthread_detach | int pthread_detach(pthread_t thread)
29 pthread_self | pthread_t pthread_self(void)
30 pthread_exit | void pthread_exit(void *out)
31 pthread_mutex_init | int pthread_mutex_init(pthread_mutex_t *m, const pthread_mutexattr_t *attr)
32 pthread_mutex_destroy | int pthread_mutex_destroy(pthread_mutex_t *m)
33 pthread_mutex_lock | int pthread_mutex_lock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
34 pthread_mutex_trylock | int pthread_mutex_trylock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
35 pthread_mutex_unlock | int pthread_mutex_unlock(pthread_mutex_t *m)
36 moy_log | int moy_log(int level, const char *text)
37 moy_term_size | int moy_term_size(int *cols, int *rows)
38 moy_timer_every | int moy_timer_every(uint32_t period_us)
39 moy_timer_cancel | int moy_timer_cancel(int timer)
40 moy_events | int moy_events(uint32_t kinds)
41 mmap | void *mmap(void *addr, size_t len, int prot, int flags, int fd, off_t off)
42 munmap | int munmap(void *addr, size_t len)
43 socket | int socket(int domain, int type, int protocol)
44 bind | int bind(int fd, const struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t len)
45 listen | int listen(int fd, int backlog)
46 accept | int accept(int fd, struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t *len)
47 connect | int connect(int fd, const struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t len)
48 send | ssize_t send(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, int flags)
49 recv | ssize_t recv(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, int flags)
50 sendto | ssize_t sendto(int fd, const void *buf, size_t n, int flags, const struct sockaddr *to, socklen_t len)
51 recvfrom | ssize_t recvfrom(int fd, void *buf, size_t n, int flags, struct sockaddr *from, socklen_t *len)
52 shutdown | int shutdown(int fd, int how)
53 setsockopt | int setsockopt(int fd, int level, int name, const void *val, socklen_t len)
54 getsockopt | int getsockopt(int fd, int level, int name, void *val, socklen_t *len)
55 getsockname | int getsockname(int fd, struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t *len)
56 getpeername | int getpeername(int fd, struct sockaddr *addr, socklen_t *len)
57 getaddrinfo | int getaddrinfo(const char *node, const char *service, const struct addrinfo *hints, struct addrinfo **res)
58 freeaddrinfo | void freeaddrinfo(struct addrinfo *ai)
59 poll | int poll(struct pollfd *fds, nfds_t n, int timeout)
60 select | int select(int n, fd_set *r, fd_set *w, fd_set *e, struct timeval *tv)
61 fcntl | int fcntl(int fd, int cmd, ...)
62 moy_files_readable | int32_t moy_files_readable(void)
63 moy_files_ready | int32_t moy_files_ready(void)
64 moy_files_list | int32_t moy_files_list(const char *kind, void *names, size_t names_cap)
65 moy_files_count | int32_t moy_files_count(const char *kind)
66 moy_files_load | int32_t moy_files_load(const char *kind, const char *name, void *data, size_t data_cap)
67 moy_files_save | int32_t moy_files_save(const char *kind, const char *name, const void *data, size_t data_len, void *saved, size_t saved_cap)
68 moy_files_delete | int32_t moy_files_delete(const char *kind, const char *name, void *trashed, size_t trashed_cap)
69 moy_nav_open_app | int32_t moy_nav_open_app(const char *id)
70 moy_prefs_get | int32_t moy_prefs_get(const char *key, void *json, size_t json_cap)
71 moy_prefs_set | int32_t moy_prefs_set(const char *key, const char *json)
72 moy_prefs_clear | int32_t moy_prefs_clear(const char *key)
73 moy_clipboard_put_text | int32_t moy_clipboard_put_text(const char *text)
74 moy_clipboard_text | int32_t moy_clipboard_text(void *text, size_t text_cap)
75 moy_clipboard_kind | int32_t moy_clipboard_kind(void)
76 moy_clipboard_seq | int32_t moy_clipboard_seq(void)
77 moy_notify | int32_t moy_notify(const char *summary, const char *body)
78 moy_open_with | int32_t moy_open_with(const char *item, int32_t choose)
79 moy_share | int32_t moy_share(const void *data, size_t data_len, const char *mime)
80 moy_send | int moy_send(const char *app, const char *name, const char *args)
81 moy_on | int moy_on(const char *name, int on)
82 moy_award | int32_t moy_award(const char *id)
83 moy_progress | int32_t moy_progress(const char *id, int32_t value)
